appearance.title: Anna
appearance.visualDescription: Young woman with short straight black hair, big brown eyes, wearing a bright red sweater and white sneakers. Friendly, warm smile.

pages.bio: Hi! I am Anna. I am 22 years old. I am tall with short black hair and brown eyes. I like bright clothes!
I usually wear a comfortable red sweater, blue jeans, and clean white sneakers. I always wear a happy smile!

greenFlags: ✓ Easy to recognize in a crowd
redFlags: ✗ Always late because of picking shoes

appearance.opener: Hello! I am Anna. Do you like red or blue sweaters?
appearance.prompt: Describe Anna using 3 simple words (hair, clothes, height).

appearance.title: Marco
appearance.visualDescription: Tall young man with curly brown hair, dark beard, green eyes, wearing a green t-shirt, denim jacket, and black glasses.

pages.bio: Hello! My name is Marco. I am 25. I have curly brown hair, green eyes, and a short beard. I wear black glasses.
My style is simple: a dark green t-shirt, blue denim jacket, and black glasses. Very casual and clean.

appearance.opener: Hi there! Do you wear glasses or have curly hair?
appearance.prompt: What color are Marco's eyes and hair?

professions.title: Baker (Chef John)
professions.visualDescription: Middle-aged man in a chef hat and white baker uniform dusting flour on fresh bread loaves in a warm bakery.

pages.bio: I am a baker! I wake up at 4:00 AM every morning. I bake fresh bread, croissants, and delicious chocolate cakes.
Work is fun! My kitchen smells like warm sugar and fresh flour. I sell delicious breakfast to happy people.

professions.opener: Good morning! Do you want fresh bread or chocolate cake today?
professions.prompt: What does a baker do every morning? Would you like this job?

professions.title: Doctor (Dr. Sarah)
professions.visualDescription: Female doctor with blonde ponytail, wearing a white coat and blue stethoscope around her neck, standing in a bright clinic.

pages.bio: I am a doctor in a hospital. I help sick people feel better. I listen to their hearts and give good medicine.
I wear a white coat and a blue stethoscope. I talk to children and adults to keep everybody healthy and happy.

professions.opener: Hello! How are you feeling today? Are you healthy?
professions.prompt: Why is a doctor's job important? Describe Dr. Sarah's uniform.

properties.title: Cozy Studio Flat
properties.visualDescription: Modern bright studio apartment with large window, wooden floor, yellow small sofa, kitchen counter, and indoor green plant.

pages.bio: I am a small, cozy studio flat! 1 big room with a yellow sofa, modern kitchen, clean bathroom, and sunny window.
Located near the bus stop and market. Perfect for 1 person or a student. Rent is $500/month.

properties.opener: Welcome inside! Do you like small cozy flats or big houses?
properties.prompt: Name 3 things inside this studio flat.

properties.title: Red Brick House
properties.visualDescription: Two-story red brick house with white fence, green grass front lawn, red roof, and garage.

pages.bio: I am a lovely red brick house! 2 bedrooms, 1 big living room, garage for 1 car, and a green garden.
Quiet green street with friendly neighbors. Safe garden for pets and kids to play fetch!

properties.opener: Hi! Would you like to sit in my green garden with tea?
properties.prompt: Is this house in the city or in a quiet village? What do you like about it?

character.title: Kind & Friendly Friend
character.visualDescription: Smiling young person holding a warm cup of cocoa, wearing a yellow beanie and soft scarf, exuding friendliness.

pages.bio: I am kind, polite, and friendly! I say 'please' and 'thank you' and I love helping my neighbors.
I smile at everyone I see on the street. I remember birthdays and bring cookies to my friends!

character.opener: Hello my friend! How can I make your day happier today?
character.prompt: What does a kind person do? Name 2 kind actions.

hobbies.title: Cycling in the Park
hobbies.visualDescription: Bright red bicycle parked under a sunny tree next to a paved park pathway.

pages.bio: Riding a red bicycle in the green park every weekend! Easy, healthy, and fun.
Feeling the cool wind in my hair while listening to music. Stopping for ice cream at the park cafe!

hobbies.opener: Hey! Do you know how to ride a bicycle?
icebreakers: No, but I want to learn!
hobbies.prompt: Where do you like to ride a bicycle or walk?

appearance.title: Elena (Athletic & Wavy Auburn Hair)
appearance.visualDescription: Athletic woman with medium shoulder-length wavy auburn hair, hazel eyes, light freckles on her nose, wearing a navy blue striped nautical shirt.

pages.bio: I am Elena, 24. I am medium height with an athletic build. I have wavy auburn hair, hazel eyes, and cute freckles.
I love casual nautical style—navy striped tops, beige shorts, and leather sandals. Ready for beach walks!

greenFlags: ✓ Warm hazel eyes that shine in the sun

appearance.opener: Hi! What is your favorite season for outdoor fashion?
appearance.prompt: Describe Elena's build, hair color, and clothing style.

appearance.title: Liam (Tall & Tailored Suit Style)
appearance.visualDescription: Tall 6'2" man with neat dark blonde side-part hair, sharp jawline, wearing a tailored navy blazer and crisp white collar shirt.

pages.bio: I am Liam! 27 years old, tall (6'2"), slim frame with broad shoulders. Short dark blonde hair and a clean-shaven face.
Smart-casual elegance: tailored navy blazers, white oxford shirts, leather watch, and polished brown shoes.

redFlags: ✗ Spends too much on dry cleaning

appearance.opener: Hello! Do you prefer dressing up formally or wearing cozy hoodies?
appearance.prompt: How tall is Liam and what clothing does he wear?

professions.title: Graphic Designer (Nina)
professions.visualDescription: Creative woman sitting with a digital drawing tablet, stylus pen, colorful posters on wall, wearing round glasses and stylish sweater.

pages.bio: I am Nina, a graphic designer! I create beautiful logos, website banners, and colorful posters for local businesses.
I work on my laptop and drawing tablet. I choose nice fonts, harmonize color palettes, and draw digital art.

professions.opener: Hey! What is your absolute favorite color combination?
professions.prompt: What tools does a graphic designer use? Would you enjoy this job?

professions.title: Fitness Trainer (Alex)
professions.visualDescription: Muscular trainer in black gym tank top, stopwatch around neck, pointing encouragingly at gym equipment.

pages.bio: I am Alex, a certified personal fitness trainer! I design exercise routines and teach people how to stay fit and strong.
I guide gym members with weights, cardio workouts, and healthy eating plans. High motivation every day!

redFlags: ✗ Waking up at 5:30 AM for clients

professions.opener: Hey! Do you prefer morning workouts or evening relaxation?
professions.prompt: What are the benefits and challenges of being a personal trainer?

properties.title: Modern Loft Apartment
properties.visualDescription: Industrial loft with high exposed concrete ceiling, big floor-to-ceiling glass windows, leather couch, and open kitchen island.

pages.bio: Spacious 1-bedroom industrial loft apartment! Features high exposed ceilings, big glass windows, and open kitchen island.
Located in the trendy Arts District with art galleries, coffee shops, and rooftop bars right downstairs. $1,200/month.

properties.opener: Hi! Do you like big open industrial lofts with city views?
properties.prompt: Describe the main features of this loft apartment.

properties.title: Suburban Cottage with Garden
properties.visualDescription: Cozy stone cottage with flower boxes under windows, wooden porch swing, green lawn, and stone chimney.

pages.bio: Charming 3-bedroom suburban cottage! Features a stone fireplace, sunny kitchen porch, and colorful flower garden.
Peaceful family neighborhood near top elementary schools and bike trails. Perfect for relaxing weekend BBQs!

redFlags: ✗ Requires lawn mowing and garden care

properties.opener: Hello! Would you like to sit on the porch swing and read a book?
properties.prompt: Compare this suburban cottage with the city loft apartment.

character.title: Organized & Reliable (Sophia)
character.visualDescription: Focused young woman checking off tasks on a colorful paper planner, smiling calmly in a neat organized desk setup.

pages.bio: I am Sophia! Very organized, punctual, and reliable. I never arrive late and I always keep my promises.
I keep a daily color-coded planner, prepare my outfits the night before, and keep my living space spotless.

character.opener: Hi! Are you someone who plans ahead or makes last-minute spontaneous decisions?
character.prompt: Why is reliability an important trait in friendship?

hobbies.title: Sourdough Bread Baking
hobbies.visualDescription: Crispy golden crusty loaf of sourdough bread dusted with flour sitting on a wooden cutting board with butter knife.

pages.bio: Baking artisanal sourdough bread from scratch! Mixing flour, water, and wild starter, then baking in a Dutch oven.
The amazing smell filling the apartment and hearing the crust crackle as it cools. Tastes incredible with salted butter!

hobbies.opener: Fresh sourdough right out of the oven! Butter or olive oil with balsamic vinegar?
hobbies.prompt: Explain the step-by-step process of sourdough baking in simple sentences.

appearance.title: Maya (Boho-Chic & Shoulder-Length Curls)
appearance.visualDescription: Artistic woman with voluminous dark brown curly hair, expressive dark eyes, wearing an embroidered bohemian kimono, layered silver rings, and turquoise earrings.

pages.bio: I'm Maya, 26. Distinctive for my expressive dark eyes, sun-kissed tan complexion, and shoulder-length dark brown curly hair.
Bohemian aesthetic: flowing embroidered cardigans, vintage silver jewelry, suede ankle boots, and artistic earthy tones.

appearance.opener: Hey! How would you describe your personal aesthetic and fashion philosophy?
appearance.prompt: Describe Maya's hairstyle, accessories, and overall aesthetic using descriptive adjectives.

appearance.title: Julian (Broad-Shouldered & Rugged Style)
appearance.visualDescription: Broad-shouldered man with a trimmed dark beard, sharp jawline, short undercut brown hair, wearing a flannel plaid shirt and leather boots.

pages.bio: I'm Julian, 29. Tall (6'1") with a rugged broad-shouldered frame, well-groomed beard, sharp jawline, and warm brown hazel eyes.
Outdoor lumberjack aesthetic: heavy-duty flannel plaid shirts, dark selvedge denim jeans, and durable leather hiking boots.

appearance.opener: Greetings! Do you favor a clean-cut corporate look or an outdoor rugged style?
appearance.prompt: Analyze Julian's physical frame, grooming habits, and clothing choices.

professions.title: Software Engineer (Marcus)
professions.visualDescription: Software engineer working at a dual-monitor standing desk, wearing headphones, coding on IDE software with dark theme.

pages.bio: I'm Marcus, a Full-Stack Software Engineer building web apps and cloud algorithms. I turn complex logic into smooth user experiences.
Writing scalable code, reviewing pull requests, solving algorithmic puzzles, and collaborating with UI designers remotely.

professions.opener: Hello world! Are you fascinated or intimidated by coding and technology?
professions.prompt: Discuss the advantages and drawbacks of a career in software engineering.

professions.title: Environmental Journalist (Clara)
professions.visualDescription: Journalist holding a recording microphone and notebook, conducting an interview outdoors with wind turbines in background.

pages.bio: I'm Clara, an investigative environmental journalist. I research renewable energy trends and write articles on climate conservation.
Interviewing scientists, traveling to nature reserves, verifying data sources, and editing impactful news features.

professions.opener: Hi! What environmental or social issue do you feel most passionate about?
professions.prompt: What skills are required to be an effective investigative journalist?

properties.title: Converted Paper Mill Loft
properties.visualDescription: Historic brick mill converted into luxury loft with red exposed brick walls, timber beams, polished concrete floor, and river view.

pages.bio: A stunning 2-bedroom loft inside a converted 19th-century paper mill. Merges original exposed brickwork and heavy timber beams with ultra-modern fixtures.
Private balcony overlooking the riverfront promenade, smart home lighting, underground garage, and private gym access. $1,850/month.

properties.opener: Welcome! Do you prefer historic renovated properties or brand-new modern architecture?
properties.prompt: Evaluate the architectural contrast between historic industrial brickwork and modern amenities.

properties.title: Eco-Friendly Solar Villa
properties.visualDescription: Sustainable two-story villa with rooftop solar panels, rainwater collection barrel, vertical plant wall, and large timber deck.

pages.bio: A state-of-the-art 3-bedroom zero-emission villa powered by rooftop solar panels, triple-pane insulation, and rainwater harvesting systems.
Organic garden patch, electric vehicle charging dock, vertical indoor plant wall, and minimal monthly electricity bills.

properties.opener: Greetings! How important is sustainable eco-friendly design when choosing a place to live?
properties.prompt: Describe the sustainable technologies integrated into this eco-friendly villa.

character.title: Empathetic & Intuitive (Daniel)
character.visualDescription: Warm-hearted man listening intently during coffee conversation, leaning forward with genuine care and active body language.

pages.bio: I'm Daniel. I pride myself on high emotional intelligence, deep empathy, and the ability to truly listen without judging.
Friends come to me when they need thoughtful advice or a safe space to vent. I value authentic connections over small talk.

character.opener: Hello! Do you consider yourself more guided by rational logic or emotional intuition?
character.prompt: How does high emotional intelligence improve interpersonal relationships?

hobbies.title: Bouldering & Rock Climbing
hobbies.visualDescription: Climber wearing chalk bag, gripping brightly colored indoor bouldering holds on an angled overhang wall.

pages.bio: Solving vertical body puzzles on indoor climbing walls and outdoor crags using chalked hands, core power, and mental focus.
Bouldering requires strategy like chess, combined with full-body functional strength. The feeling when completing a tough V5 route is unbeatable!

greenFlags: ✓ Exceptional core and upper body strength

hobbies.opener: Hey! Have you ever attempted indoor bouldering or rock climbing?
hobbies.prompt: In what ways does bouldering combine physical endurance with mental problem solving?

appearance.title: Victoria (Statuesque Elegance & Platinum Bob)
appearance.visualDescription: Statuesque 5'10" woman with a razor-sharp platinum blonde bob, piercing ice-blue eyes, high cheekbones, wearing an asymmetrical black blazer and understated gold hoop earrings.

pages.bio: I'm Victoria, 29. Statuesque frame (5'10") featuring prominent high cheekbones, striking ice-blue eyes, and a precision-cut platinum blonde bob.
High-fashion minimalist tailoring: monochromatic suits, structured blazers, sleek leather boots, and subtle designer accents.

appearance.opener: Welcome! How significantly does first impression and sartorial elegance influence your personal perception?
appearance.prompt: Examine the stylistic impact of Victoria's minimalist wardrobe, hair structure, and demeanor.

appearance.title: Gabriel (Charismatic & Silver-Templed Style)
appearance.visualDescription: Charismatic 34-year-old man with distinguished silver-templed dark hair, captivating dimples, wearing a tailored charcoal wool coat and silk scarf.

pages.bio: I'm Gabriel, 34. Athletic height (6'0"), distinguished silver-templed wavy dark hair, warm hazel eyes, and expressive dimples when laughing.
Classic European sophistication: charcoal wool overcoats, tailored cashmere turtlenecks, antique leather loafers, and vintage timepiece.

redFlags: ✗ Takes vintage timepiece care too seriously

appearance.opener: Greetings! Do you believe personal style should evolve continuously or anchor to timeless classicism?
appearance.prompt: Analyze how Gabriel's physical attributes convey maturity, charisma, and sophistication.

professions.title: AI Ethics Researcher (Dr. Aris)
professions.visualDescription: Researcher reviewing algorithmic bias data on transparent holographic displays in a high-tech university research lab.

pages.bio: I'm Dr. Aris, an Artificial Intelligence Ethics Researcher. I evaluate machine learning models for algorithmic bias, data privacy compliance, and societal safety.
Publishing peer-reviewed policy frameworks, advising tech executives, and auditing large language models to prevent discrimination in automated decisions.

greenFlags: ✓ Pioneering the frontier of tech safety
redFlags: ✗ Complex ethical dilemmas without clear answers

professions.opener: Greetings! In your opinion, should artificial intelligence development be strictly regulated by international law?
professions.prompt: Evaluate the ethical implications and societal responsibilities of AI ethics researchers.

professions.title: Architectural Conservationist (Soren)
professions.visualDescription: Architect in hardhat examining intricate stonework details of a historic cathedral restoration project using laser scanning tools.

pages.bio: I'm Soren, an Architectural Conservationist. I specialize in adaptive reuse—restoring landmark historic structures while adapting them for sustainable modern utility.
3D laser scanning ancient masonry, sourcing period-accurate ecological materials, and preventing historical landmarks from demolition.

greenFlags: ✓ Preserving cultural heritage for future generations

professions.opener: Hello! How can cities balance preserving historical architecture with building modern housing infrastructure?
professions.prompt: Debate the balance between historical architectural preservation and urban modernization.

properties.title: Penthouse Sky Villa
properties.visualDescription: Luxury penthouse terrace with private infinity glass pool, panoramic 360-degree skyline views, fire pit, and floor-to-ceiling glass walls.

pages.bio: Exquisite 4,500 sq ft top-floor Sky Villa featuring a private glass-edge infinity pool, 360-degree city skyline panoramas, and full biometric smart automation.
Private elevator entry, climate-controlled wine cellar, motorized glass curtain walls, and rooftop helipad access. $6,500/month.

redFlags: ✗ High altitude sway during strong storms

properties.opener: Welcome to the sky! Does extreme luxury housing justify its social and environmental footprint?
properties.prompt: Analyze the architectural engineering and lifestyle dynamics of luxury high-rise penthouse living.

properties.title: Alpine Timber Chalet
properties.visualDescription: Rustic luxurious timber chalet nestled in snow-covered pine mountains, featuring cathedral glass facade, outdoor cedar sauna, and roaring stone hearth.

pages.bio: A magnificent 4-bedroom timber chalet carved into alpine peaks. Showcases floor-to-ceiling cathedral windows framing snowy mountain vistas and a massive stone hearth.
Ski-in ski-out access, outdoor cedar wood sauna, geothermal floor heating, and custom oak furniture crafted by local artisans.

redFlags: ✗ Snowplowing road access in heavy blizzards

properties.opener: Greetings! Would you thrive living surrounded by alpine wilderness, or do you require urban velocity?
properties.prompt: Evaluate how living in isolated natural terrain affects psychological well-being and daily routine.

character.title: Visionary & Resilient (Helena)
character.visualDescription: Determined female leader standing atop a conference hall terrace, looking strategically toward the city skyline with confidence and poise.

pages.bio: I'm Helena, 32. Characterized by strategic foresight, formidable resilience under pressure, and an unwavering commitment to empowering those around me.
I view setbacks as crucial data points for growth. I lead with transparency, encourage bold calculated risk-taking, and foster accountability.

character.opener: Greetings! What key quality distinguishes a true leader from a boss?
character.prompt: Differentiate between transactional management and transformative resilient leadership.

hobbies.title: 35mm Analog Film Photography
hobbies.visualDescription: Vintage Leica film camera resting on a darkroom wooden bench next to developed negatives, amber safelight glowing in background.

pages.bio: Capturing urban moments on 35mm silver halide film with deliberate composition—limiting oneself to 36 exposures per roll without instant digital previews.
Developing negatives manually in chemical darkrooms, embracing grain textures, subtle light leaks, and authentic unedited candid humanity.

hobbies.opener: Greetings! How does the deliberate constraint of analog media alter human creative expression compared to digital abundance?
hobbies.prompt: Critique the psychological and artistic differences between digital smartphone photography and 35mm film photography.
